$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target would pair with. CI rebuilds it
from the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
'patchSets' names the patch sets this build takes on top of common, as
directories under the patch submodule's patches/<version>/. Asteroids
takes devices/asteroids in addition to common. Nothing OS has no
KDP/RKP/DEFEX; the device set recreates the zygote-start boundary only
after late-load-compatible module setup, mounts and post-mount are complete.
It is selected by the explicit --modules path, not by a hard-coded Zygisk ID.
